theorem.statement:
There is a finite constant \(K_{\mathrm{res}}\), depending only on
\((c,C,G)\), such that for every \(N\geq N_0\),
\[
 \sup_{p\in\mathcal P,\,|\gamma|\leq G}
 \mathbb E_{\rho_{1,N}}
 \left|\{G_{1,N}-\mathcal L_{\gamma_N}\}
 h_{1,N}(X_{1,N})\right|
 \leq K_{\mathrm{res}}N^{-1/2}.
\]
This bound includes every state for which an available upward or downward
lattice jump crosses \(\gamma_N\).
theorem.justification: The pointwise Taylor envelope and stationary moment bound prove the previously isolated residual uniformly through the moving kink.
theorem.gap: This theorem now closes, rather than merely states, the finite-to-diffusion centering remainder.
theorem.consumer: It certifies when the simpler diffusion fitted center can replace exact product-law evaluation.
theorem.proof_tex: This is exactly the claim of thm:kink-residual-bound; apply thm:kink-residual-bound.
